## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today? Describe
the problem before the solution.

## Proposal

How you would like Cortex to behave. For API changes, include an example
request and response.


## Alternatives considered

Other approaches or workarounds, and why they fall short.
